thread.subject: Quick call about the analyst role?
thread.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for applying to the summer analyst program. I'd love to set up a 30-minute call to tell you more about the team and answer your questions. What does your availability look like over the next week or so?

Best,
Jordan

past_messages.subject: Northbridge info session follow-up
past_messages.body: Great meeting you at the info session! I usually do calls in the mornings before the market gets busy, so keep that in mind if we ever set something up.
